comment: Independent cheap B92 H→M natural-wraith variation: a lawful Valkyrie uses the wizard-mode polymorph/create commands, then attacks the C-observed ogre directly south once. The saved C trace shows hmonas lands the wraith touch, damageum selects AD_DRLI, rn2(3)=0 succeeds, and the ogre becomes weaker. The role change exercises the same source arm under different hero attributes and startup state.
